title: BBC Learning English from the News 2026 — Quiz 5
description: Choose the best answer for each question about vocabulary and usage.

elements.name: q041_astronomical
elements.title: The repairs would cost an ___ sum, far beyond anything the owners could afford.

elements.name: q042_reckoning
elements.title: Years of ignored complaints finally led to a ___, as an inquiry exposed failures and managers faced consequences.

elements.name: q043_golden_age
elements.title: During the town's ___ of filmmaking, local studios thrived and produced many celebrated films.

elements.name: q044_flock
elements.title: Birdwatchers often ___ to the reserve when the rare birds arrive.

elements.name: q045_knock_off
elements.title: The bag looked like a designer original, but its label and stitching showed it was a ___.

elements.name: q046_runaway
elements.title: The novel became a ___ success, selling far more copies than anyone had predicted.

elements.name: q047_whipped_up
elements.title: The speaker's dramatic claims ___ fear in the audience and made people more anxious.

elements.name: q048_push_something_up_the_agenda
elements.title: The latest breakdown pushed repairs ___ the agenda, making them the first item for discussion.

elements.name: q049_jump_ship
elements.title: When the organisation ran into trouble, several senior staff decided to ___ and join another employer.

elements.name: q050_mourn
elements.title: Longtime readers gathered to ___ the loss of the local newspaper after its final issue.
